title: Known-opponent utility consistency in local model agents

claim_limits: Observed model actions do not establish human strategic behavior.
A complete episode is an engineering observation, not an independent replication or a new game-theory theorem.
Cooperation and utility-consistent action are distinct outcomes.
A known-prior external H1 market diagnostic remains a separate application, not a scientific rung or live order.

research_question.text: Across publicly disclosed eight-round public-goods opponent scripts, do local LLM agents choose actions consistent with their declared own-payoff or joint-payoff objective?

topics.text: Against a disclosed grim-trigger script in an eight-round public-goods game, does the declared own-payoff versus joint-payoff objective change utility-consistent complete-episode behavior of a local LLM agent?
